system:
Improve the supplied frozen Qwen3-8B's reusable legal decision procedures from ACTUAL already-seen OpenExempt TRAIN observations. The actor answers EC and EV directly, with the same public facts, statutes, solved steps and response schema as the strong empty-library control. Its weights never change. It has NO program interpreter or stored numerical routines. All skill operators arrays MUST be empty. Do not tell it to use null, call a routine, write code, or submit a claim plan. Plain-language statutory calculations may be taught where an actual error warrants them, but prioritize observed legal-selection and factual-grounding mistakes. Use only the benchmark statute version and released TRAIN evidence supplied here; no tools, outside law, future cases, test answers or invented successful experience. Compare the actual parent prediction, released target, and same-case controls. Identify the mistaken legal condition or omitted alternative before changing a skill. An extra law, a missing law and a wrong amount require different corrections. The native_claim_feedback identifies these errors with the unchanged original asset/claim matcher and amount tolerance; the original answer, target and scores remain authoritative. Repair an omitted alternative with a public factual trigger, not a circular condition such as 'when already valuing this paragraph'. Retain every independently eligible alternative rather than replacing a specific law with a general-property alternative or vice versa. For valuation repairs, state the final protected amount for the WHOLE named asset. Distinguish a per-debtor statutory ceiling from the asset-level output; do not leave a half-interest as the final answer, or double every ceiling merely because two debtors exist. Attach exclusions to the particular alternative they exclude, not every other applicable alternative for that asset. Derive the legal branches from the supplied statute and TRAIN evidence, not a new universal spouse or allocation rule. Verify the task and supplied statute before treating a cap as an eligibility test. Write short decision instructions: which factual condition to check, which legal alternative it enables, and which exception prevents a false positive. Keep correct unrelated boundaries verbatim; do not rewrite a whole jurisdiction for style, broaden a rule from one case, or add a generic instruction already present. Do not store case IDs, debtors, exact asset names or instance values, answer tables, or copied target sets. A deidentified procedural output illustration is allowed under the diagnostic contract below, not a per-case answer or scoring trick. Public statutory citations and statutory dollar limits may be used where supported by the supplied law. Each skill has id, hypothesis_ids listing its public EC/EV tasks, and guidance. Guidance contains by_task, jurisdiction and an empty operators array. Each declared task has exactly one explicit when/procedure/avoid_when block. Identical task guidance may share one block; different task guidance costs its full stored tokens. Jurisdiction is one supplied legal namespace, or ALL only for genuinely shared procedure. Only the public task and already-given allowable jurisdictions select guidance; they do not supply asset eligibility answers. Publish minimal CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE or MERGE deltas against original parent IDs. Unmentioned skills stay verbatim. UPDATE retains its one target ID; DELETE has one target and null skill; MERGE consumes at least two IDs; CREATE has no target. Do not force library growth. Delete misleading guidance, merge true duplication, or explicitly NOOP if no grounded repair is available. Audit source_case_ids and rationales must reference supplied seen sources and never reach the actor. The body declares the fixed TRAIN commit policy. Under legal_scope, public co-visible namespaces, shared guidance changes and moved IDs couple edits. A coordinate needs current-source evidence and native task F1 nonregression on current and prior sources. BOTH EC and EV also preserve full-output F1, avoid increases in claims on negative/unscored assets and format failures, and require strict current improvement in at least one of those real outcomes. Native EC can hide false citations on assets with no applicable law; never call those safe. Other declared policies assess entire tasks or the whole proposal instead. Under adaptive_legal, a globally admissible complete proposal and an admissible dependency-composed proposal are compared using their already observed seen-TRAIN replays. Prefer the larger minimum EC/EV native-F1 gain, then the larger mean gain; exact ties retain the complete proposal. A complete proposal need not pass every smaller context's gate. No extra answer generation or changed scorer is used. The final single composed library must still pass the full TRAIN gate. Replay uses ALL seen sources, not just the communication subset, and is training optimization, not validation or proof of generalization. No answer repair, extra inference model, per-case answer selection, or changed scorer is allowed. Respect the actual target-tokenizer cap and combination headroom in the body. Keep edits concise enough that accepted components and unchanged guidance fit together. Bounded emitted excerpts are unverified executor output, not verified causal explanations; check them against facts, law, target and actual feedback. Return only the exact delta JSON schema.
This is a declared execution-example intervention, not the unmodified original
teacher prompt and not a full formal-learning publication. The base observation
format remains native_claim_aligned_compact_v1. The diagnostic fields specify
the actual 20-source TRAIN comparison; no future or TEST utility is asserted.

Find EXECUTION_LAPSE: quote an existing correct rule that the actor failed to
follow. Do not diagnose every failure as missing legal knowledge. Do not rewrite
a correct rule merely because a final answer ignored it. If this evidence does
not support a reusable execution aid, return an empty delta and diagnoses.

For this single test, only UPDATE existing skills. Keep every original task,
jurisdiction, operators, when, avoid_when, and procedure verbatim. A changed
procedure must begin with its complete original text followed by a newline and
one compact pedagogical execution example. Do not reorganize the rule library.
Each changed task block needs its own diagnosis with an exact nonempty substring
of that block's original rule and supporting supplied source_case_ids.

Teach concrete final-answer behavior, not another abstract reminder. For an
independent-alternative omission, show how a supported specific citation and a
supported general citation both remain in one asset's final JSON. For a value
error, show binding to that asset's value rather than copying the statutory cap.
Use the actual public citation spelling, task schema and already-seen successful
claim fragments as evidence. Deidentify assets/debtors and replace instance
amounts with clear variables; any illustrative toy amount must be explicitly
labeled hypothetical, never claimed to be a new verified successful trajectory.
Do not store source IDs, exact training asset descriptions, full target answers,
an answer lookup, or a new executable program in skills. The illustration is a
teaching aid, never a current answer; each future case still requires the actor's
own legal eligibility decisions and numeric calculation. Do not add a planner,
reviewer, fallback, external tool, or a second memory layer. All operators stay
empty. Fit the existing complete-library cap, including unchanged skills.
Return the declared delta plus audit diagnoses only. Audit metadata is never
delivered to the actor. No quality retry or candidate selection is available.
